Zanzibar Island offers a laidback beach life, but also a large variety of activities, a colorful culture and a deep history. blocks.html: Together with Pemba Island and a host of smaller islands, Zanzibar forms the Zanzibar Archipelago. On Zanzibar Island you will find relaxed beach life alongside a wide choice of activities, a vibrant culture and a long history. Join a spice tour, or head out to the remarkable coral reefs and swim among tropical reef […]

blocks.orig: Pemba Island is one of the lesser known islands of the Zanzibar Archipelago. It is however a popular honeymoon destination. If you are looking for rest, tranquility and a romantic atmosphere – this is the place to be! The coral reefs surrounding the entire island form a magnificent playground for snorkelers and divers. The Pemba […]
blocks.html: Among the islands of the Zanzibar Archipelago, Pemba Island is one of the least familiar to visitors. Even so, honeymooners choose it often. If what you want is calm, quiet and a romantic setting, you will feel at home here. Coral reefs ring the whole island and give snorkelers and divers a superb place to explore. The Pemba […]

blocks.orig: Mnemba Island is an exclusive barefoot paradise off the northeast coast of Zanzibar, owned by &Beyond (a luxury safari company). A triangular shaped reef – part of the Marine Protected Area – surrounds this island with its beautiful scuba dive sites, corals, fish and stunning ocean views. This is how you stay! blocks.html: Off the northeast coast of Zanzibar lies Mnemba Island, a private barefoot retreat owned by &Beyond, a luxury safari company. The island is encircled by a triangular reef, part of the Marine Protected Area, with fine scuba dive sites, corals, fish and wide ocean views. blocks.orig: Mafia Island is a perfect escape from the fast pace and busy daily life. This island is still pure and untouched, which means there are no tarmac roads and only few tourists. It’s like Zanzibar a few decades ago. The atmosphere is peaceful and the islanders are very friendly. Mafia is part of the Zanzibar Archipelago […]
blocks.html: If you want to leave the rush of everyday life behind, Mafia Island is an ideal escape. The island remains pure and undeveloped: there are no tarmac roads and visitors are few. Think of Zanzibar as it was a few decades ago. The mood is peaceful and the islanders welcome you warmly. Mafia belongs to the Zanzibar Archipelago […]

blocks.orig: The Fanjove Private Island is part of the Songo Songo Archipelago, a group of five islands south of Mafia Island. blocks.html: Fanjove Private Island belongs to the Songo Songo Archipelago, a cluster of five islands lying south of Mafia Island. Warm Indian Ocean waters sustain a rich variety of plants and animals in this captivating setting, below the surface and on the shore alike. blocks.orig: Chumbe Island Coral Park is an award-winning private nature reserve. It is located only a few kilometers off the southwest coast of Zanzibar, near Stone Town. blocks.html: Chumbe Island Coral Park is a private nature reserve that has won awards. You will find it just a few kilometres off Zanzibar's southwest coast, close to Stone Town.
